name: machines-ec2
title: Machines on EC2
description: A Work server's machines on Amazon EC2 as project code: create and destroy workflows for a workflow machine class, launching with an idempotency token from the enrollment and terminating until the instance is gone.
docs:
Install into a project only the Work server's administrators reach: its create runs carry one-time enrollment codes. The Work server guide's "Machines on demand" covers the server side.

1. Copy the files to their targets, and add the manifest's `@aws-sdk/client-ec2` dependency to `.work/workflows/package.json`.
2. Create the IAM policy in the installed `.work/skills/machines-ec2/SKILL.md` for the class's tag, and set `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` as project secrets.
3. Check the project (`program_check`), deploy, and turn `createMachine` and `destroyMachine` on for the project.
4. Add a `workflow` class naming this project, `createMachine`, `destroyMachine` and the EC2 options to the server's `WORK_MACHINES_CONFIG`, restart the server, and write a machine rule for it, as the installed skill says ("Set up the class and a rule").
